        # If total_distance is even, X + total_distance and X - total_distance
        # have the same parity, so the minimum absolute value is |X|.
        min_abs_value = abs(X)
    else:
        # If total_distance is odd, X + total_distance and X - total_distance
        # have different parities. We need to adjust one of the moves.
        # Consider moving one step back to make the total distance even.
        # New total distance is (K * D) - D, which is even.
        min_abs_value = min(abs(X + D), abs(X - D))
    
    print(min_abs_value)
